description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard functionality, verifying directory permissions, socket removal, and symlink handling within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuardTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard regarding socket file handling and directory permissions.

methods.name: harden parent directory creates directory with0700 permissions
methods.description: Tests that the parent directory of a socket path is created with 0700 permissions.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects symlink path
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to remove a socket at a symlink path properly rejects the operation with the appropriate error.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects regular file path
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to remove a regular file as a socket path is rejected appropriately.
